name: Aetheen of the Gales
summary: On Zephras Isle, young adventurers who pass their first trials go to meet Aetheen of the Gales at Thendal Grove. There, the next generation faces her judgment.

sections.title: A Measure of Potential
sections.body: Young novices on Zephras Isle take on early duties that test their grit and spirit. The island's mentors watch for those ready to help defend their home. Rorian the Dayseeker notices youths prepared for greater responsibility.

sections.title: The Wind-Reader of Thendal Grove
sections.body: At Thendal Grove, Aetheen of the Gales reads the currents of the air. She belongs to the Council of Elders, which governs Zephras Isle, and assesses young shen'dorei as they come of age. Reporting to her takes you beyond minor duties along the island's perimeter and toward threats facing the community.

faq.q: Who is Aetheen of the Gales?
faq.answer: Aetheen of the Gales leads on Zephras Isle and serves on its Council of Elders. At Thendal Grove, she reads the winds and assesses young shen'dorei coming of age, judging whether they are ready to defend their home.

faq.q: Why does Rorian send players to meet Aetheen?
faq.answer: After their early duties, Rorian the Dayseeker sends capable and resilient novices to Aetheen. She judges their skills and directs them toward greater challenges facing the island.

faq.q: Where can Aetheen of the Gales be found?
faq.answer: Aetheen of the Gales can be found in Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. There she reads the winds and oversees coming-of-age trials for local youths.

faq.q: What is the Council of Elders?
faq.answer: The Council of Elders governs the shen'dorei on Zephras Isle. Aetheen and the other council leaders guide their community's survival, leadership, and readiness.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Aetheen?
faq.answer: Once Aetheen judges a young adventurer ready to serve Zephras Isle, she assigns serious work against dangers in the local wilderness, including aggressive wildlife and foul matriarchs.

faq.q: What does 'coming of age' mean for shen'dorei on Zephras Isle?
faq.answer: For young shen'dorei on Zephras Isle, coming of age means proving themselves through physical and magical trials. They show an island elder like Aetheen that they can serve before taking on that duty.
